title: Component
description: A Component is a discrete, renderable UI element — a 'Lego brick' for composing user experiences. Components describe what can be rendered, not how it is rendered. Rendering decisions belong to the consumer. A Component may have zero or more Controllers that drive its behavior.

componentId.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this component (e.g. 'product-carousel'). Must be unique within a Catalog.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for this component (e.g. 'Product Carousel').

description.description: Human-readable description of this component's purpose and rendering intent.

controllers.description: Map of Controller definitions attached to this component. Each controller is responsible for a distinct concern. An empty object is valid for purely static components.
